profile.headline: DevOps Analyst | Full Stack Developer | Media Maker
profile.summary: Maximizing the benefits of computer technology for others and building effective working relationships drives me to achieve results.  As a software developer overcoming challenges within a team gives me the ability to empower people and businesses on a global scale.

positions.title: DevOps Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · OpenShift · Git · Jenkins · Jira

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Technical Lead of 3-6 full-stack engineers.
Responsible for writing concise code, product planning, driving technical design, and owning technical delivery.
Implemented automated UI testing for new and existing functional components.
Mentored teammates to develop technical and leadership skills. Participated in Agile rituals and ceremonies.
Drove application consolidation and code deployments. 
Technologies used: Java, Angular, SQL, Jenkins, JUnit, Selenium.

positions.title: Canvasser
positions.description: Engage, educate and registered voters for action on non-partisan ballot initiatives.

positions.title: Driver
positions.description: World class customer service while delivering and event set up for clients.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Oversaw first profit in restaurant 7 year history.  Track sales, labor and operation costs.  Hire and train employees, create employee schedule, track and order inventory,  manage vendors.

positions.title: Desktop Support Specialist
positions.description: Tier 2 level desktop support in person, over the phone and remotely for corporate headquarters and remote and traveling employees.

positions.title: Systems Technician
positions.description: Responsible for the successful operation of data processing including routine computer system operations and functions; deployment, support and maintenance of software; maintains supplies, logs and schedules.

positions.title: PC Systems Specialist Assistant
positions.description: Technical support to faculty and staff for instruction, research, and administration.

positions.title: Independent Media Production Specialist
positions.description: Assist clients with productions within their given budget and production schedule.  I offer technical and non-technical production training, audio/visual support for television, theatre, and film in all phases of production.  I am a SBE certified Television Operator and my specialties include: live event video switching, non-linear editing (PC & Mac), cinematography, production management, media technology training, and video encoding.

positions.title: Youth Instructor/I.T. Specialist
positions.description: Train youth in technical and non-technical aspects of television production in both studio and field productions.  Also, provide technology consulting with management staff to implement new technology or troubleshoot existing hardware and software.

positions.title: Helpdesk Analyst
positions.description: Provided technical support for both hardware and software problems to 30,000+ end-users for Coca-Cola Enterprises’ worldwide network.  Remotely supported clients in a live production environment to quickly minimize the impact of technical issues on business operations.

positions.title: Production Assistant
positions.description: Assist crew in studio, field and special event video productions.

positions.title: Support and Operations Technician
positions.description:
Provided both remote and hands-on support for hardware and software technical issues
to 100+ users. Performed daily system operations, performance monitoring, backups, and
maintenance.

positions.title: Systems Technician
positions.description:
Responsible for the deployment, support, and maintenance of hardware and
software; system operations and functions; data processing; and maintained supplies and logs.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Software Engineering - Java Full Stack Development

volunteerExperiences.description: Researched and installed hardware and software upgrades to improve video editing workflow.  Collaborated in implementing PBS COVE H.264 web video encoding specifications. Videographer for local online web series.
Established the Atlanta's chapter first lending library to members to expand technology and customer service skills.
